Preparing the painted scenery and residents.

What this study tests

Two painted characters share continuous walking and reaching motion, with separate body parts and bags. Feet plant during each stance; the body rises and falls over them. The resident turns away to approach the shop, reaches for its handle, moves it with her hand, and steps into a painted interior. She also bends to smell the flowers.

Use Close-up to follow either resident. This is still an animation experiment: joint seams, turns, and contact choreography need visual judgment. Afternoon, evening, and rain are manual studies; live Seattle weather, a full population, runtime artwork generation, and evolving stories are not connected. Evening still inherits baked sunlight from the afternoon painting.

The original prototype and earlier movement study are available separately.
